title: X-Dubbing: Speech-to-Speech Translation under Temporal and Visual Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.32042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-lingual dubbing aims to convert source speech into target-language speech that remains synchronized with the original video. The key to this task is to produce a faithful translation that is naturally speakable within the source timing, which is non-trivial because languages differ in duration, rhythm, and articulation. In this paper, we propose X-Dubbing, which formulates the task as a joint problem of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech. Specifically, our method consists of a Dubbing Translator that generates temporally structured scripts and a Voice Actor that renders them in synchrony with the source video, both grounded in a language-agnostic timing budget. We further refine the translator with dubbing-aware feedback from the synthesized speech, encouraging scripts that yield well-synchronized dubbing. This design requires no paired dubbing data, as the two components are trained on speech-text

translated_title: X-Dubbing：时间与视觉约束下的语音到语音翻译
translated_abstract: 跨语言配音旨在将源语音转换为目标语言的语音，并保持与原视频的同步。这项任务的关键在于生成忠实的翻译，同时使其能够在源语音的时间限制内自然地朗读出来，而这并非易事，因为不同语言在时长、节奏和发音方式上存在差异。在本文中，我们提出 X-Dubbing，将这一任务形式化为时间感知的语音到文本翻译与视频感知的文本到语音的联合问题。具体而言，我们的方法由一个生成时间结构化脚本的配音翻译器和一个将脚本与源视频同步渲染的配音演员组成，二者均基于与语言无关的时间预算。我们进一步利用来自合成语音的配音感知反馈对翻译器进行优化，鼓励其生成能够产生良好同步配音的脚本。该设计无需成对的配音数据，因为这两个组件均在语音-文本
tldr: X-Dubbing 将跨语言配音形式化为时间感知的语音到文本翻译与视频感知的文本到语音合成的联合任务，在无需成对配音数据的情况下即可生成与原视频时间同步的目标语言配音。
en_tdlr: X-Dubbing formulates cross-lingual dubbing as a joint task of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech, producing temporally synchronized target-language dubbing without requiring paired dubbing data.
